cache.note: Mathlib used its standard tool-managed shared download cache (MATHLIB_CACHE_DIR and XDG_CACHE_HOME unset). Project dependency checkouts and compiled files are in the isolated scratch .lake; the original project .lake was not created.

initial_targeted_attempt.reason: A fresh dependency/source build was stopped at its explicit bound; this was not a network failure or a theorem error. Five local family112 prerequisites had built; the target theorem had not yet been verified.

targeted_compilation.source_warning: Only ComparatorChallenges/DepthThree.lean:133:8 declaration uses sorry; intentional template sorry text at line 140, not a solution gap.

configured_comparator.command: export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; lake env comparator ComparatorChallenges/DepthThree.json
acceptance_output: Running Lean default kernel on solution.
Lean default kernel accepts the solution

elaborated_theorem_axioms.method: lake env lean on a scratch file importing only the solution module, using #print axioms on the exact named target and its two supporting theorems.

static_source_scan.method: Lexical direct-import DFS in archived repository sources; nested comments and strings masked. Not a Lean parser, elaborator, declaration-dependency analyzer, axiom checker, or proof of absence of metaprogrammatic introduction of axioms.
static_source_scan.target_statement_whitespace_normalized: ∃ (L : List Bool → Bool) (M : FiniteMultiTapeMachine) (C a : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ 0 < a ∧ (∀ w : List Bool, MultiTapeHaltsIn M w (L w) (C * (w.length + 1) ^ a)) ∧ ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ D : Circuit3 (Fin n), D.Computes (fun x => L (List.ofFn x)) → (2 : ℝ) ^ (A * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) < (D.gateCount : ℝ)
static_source_scan.statement_comparison_limitation: Text-only statement comparison, not comparator execution or comparison of elaborated constants/definitions.
static_source_scan.classification: Static source scan only; actual elaborated axiom dependencies are reported separately.

external_source_boundary.scope: Immediate external boundary of the complete 175-module repository import closure; not an external-library axiom-dependency scan.

limitations: This validates only the theorem and model encoded in the supplied DepthThree configuration; it does not establish a resolution of P versus NP or analyze manuscript correspondence, CSP extensions, or internal-oracle locality.
Nanoda is disabled in the supplied configuration and was not enabled. The comparator did run Lean default kernel and accepted the solution.

Mathlib/dependency build artifacts were obtained from the exact-pin cache; a from-source rebuild of every upstream library was not completed. The local solution closure compiled, and the comparator kernel check passed.

The lexical/static scan covers all 175 repository modules in the solution import closure and resolves its 82 immediate external module sources; it is not a static scan of every transitive external library. Actual target axiom dependencies were checked separately.
The comparator executable did not expose a usable version flag. Its exact binary SHA-256 is recorded; its source revision was not established.
The first bounded build timed out, but later targeted build and comparator checks both completed successfully; it must not be mistaken for the final outcome.

reproduction.prerequisites: Recorded pinned Lean v4.34.1 and comparator, landrun, lean4export binaries on PATH; network access to exact dependency revisions and cache.

set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/rou/src/math
commit=fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb
scratch=$(mktemp -d /tmp/family112-reproduction.XXXXXX)
git -C "$repo" archive "$commit" lean | tar -x -C "$scratch"
cd "$scratch/lean"
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
lean --version
lake --version
# Existing lockfile is retained. Do NOT run lake update.
lake exe cache get
lake build +OAI.Computability.DepthThree.Main +ComparatorChallenges.DepthThree
lake env comparator ComparatorChallenges/DepthThree.json
cat > "$scratch/VerifyFamily112.lean" <<'LEAN'
import OAI.Computability.DepthThree.Main
#print axioms OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.exists_polynomial_time_language_depth_three_lower_bound
LEAN
lake env lean "$scratch/VerifyFamily112.lean"
